description.zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口[ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~)或[ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to obtain the ID of the task flow.

description.zh: 任务流运行记录ID（Id），可通过调用接口[ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the execution record of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlowInstance](~~424689~~) operation to obtain the execution record ID.

description.zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口[GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~)或[ListUserTenants](~~198074~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the tenant. You can call the [GetUserActiveTenant](~~198073~~) or [ListUserTenants](~~198074~~) operation to obtain the tenant ID.

title.zh: 获取任务流运行记录的节点信息
